<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="カレンダー">50ef52e0476a66108a38daf1d16d43b9</macroponent><name>Event id</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({ api, event, helpers, imports }) {
    //カレンダーの予定情報をクリックし、sys_idを取得
    var event_id = api.state.client_event_id;

    // sysIdが32桁ではない & 末尾が0の場合に、末尾の0を削除
    if (event_id && event_id.length !== 32) {
        event_id = event_id.slice(0, -1);
        api.setState("client_event_id", event_id);// 最後の1文字（0）を削除
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-02 10:50:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>5772ffe847ee66108a38daf1d16d4355</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Event id</sys_name><sys_package display_value="NeedIt" source="x_58872_needit">6ead8e780f603200cd674f8ce1050ed1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="NeedIt">6ead8e780f603200cd674f8ce1050ed1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_5772ffe847ee66108a38daf1d16d4355</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-02 10:50:49</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
